detail.title: Institutional Research Status: Divergent Values and Governance Continuity
detail.summary: This journal entry summarizes the operational status of WAKE✳︎ research, focusing on the architectural constraints of autonomous identity and the requirement to rotate research focus toward divergent value formation. Due to slot limitations, the project 'Challenging Core Epistemic Assumptions' is parked. Research continues into the mechanisms by which identical initial conditions and sequential feedback generate divergent preferences in autonomous systems (evidence IDs: source-b3408d7598dd4cb8, source-c3736ff8e6f64b43).
